entries.title: Psalms 148:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.

entries.title: Psalms 148:2
segments: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.

entries.title: Psalms 148:3
segments: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.

entries.title: Psalms 148:4
segments: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 148:5
segments: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.

entries.title: Psalms 148:6
segments: He hath also established them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.

entries.title: Psalms 148:7
segments: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps.

entries.title: Psalms 148:8
segments: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;

entries.title: Psalms 148:9
segments: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;

entries.title: Psalms 148:10
segments: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;

entries.title: Psalms 148:11
segments: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 148:12
segments: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:

entries.title: Psalms 148:13
segments: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 148:14
segments: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.
